name: code unchanged
description: The saved code equals the current code.

name: unknown component
description: No current component has the saved node's type.

name: code changed only
description: Only the code changed.

name: new optional input
description: The component gained an optional input.

name: new required input with a default
description: The component gained a required input that has a usable default.

name: new required input, no default
description: The component gained a required input that nobody gave a value.

name: output renamed
description: The output name changed, so edges from the old name drop.

name: output added
description: The component gained an output. No saved edge uses it.

name: output removed
description: The component dropped an output the saved node has.

name: output method changed
description: The output calls a different method.

name: output loop turned on
description: The output now allows loops.

name: output loop turned off
description: The output no longer allows loops.

name: component declares no outputs
description: The saved node has an output, and the component declares none (Run Flow, Smart Router, Text Operations).

name: saved node has no outputs key
description: The saved node carries no outputs, so nothing tells which outputs had edges.

name: output display_name changed
description: Only the output display name changed.

name: output types widened
description: The output can produce more types.

name: output types narrowed
description: The output no longer produces a type the saved node produced.

name: output type order changed
description: The output type list was reordered.

name: output type Data is now JSON
description: The output declares JSON where the saved node had Data.

name: output type DataFrame is now Table
description: The output declares Table where the saved node had DataFrame.

name: input_types widened
description: The input accepts more types.

name: input_types narrowed, connected
description: The connected input no longer accepts a type the saved node accepted.

name: input_types narrowed, not connected
description: The input no longer accepts a type the saved node accepted, and no edge goes into it.

name: input_types emptied, connected
description: The connected input no longer accepts connections.

name: input_types emptied, not connected
description: The input no longer accepts connections, and no edge goes into it.

name: input type Data is now JSON
description: The input accepts JSON where the saved node accepted Data.

name: input type DataFrame is now Table
description: The input accepts Table where the saved node accepted DataFrame.

name: input field removed, connected
description: The component dropped a field the saved node has, and an edge goes into it.

name: input field removed, not connected
description: The component dropped a field the saved node has. No edge goes into it.

name: field added while editing
description: The saved node has a field a Run Flow node added for its selected flow.

name: input field type changed, connected
description: The connected field type changed from str to dict, so its edge drops.

name: input field type changed, not connected
description: The field type changed from str to dict, no edge goes into it, and it is empty.

name: input field type changed, not connected, holds a value
description: The field type changed from str to dict, and the update drops its saved value.

name: input field type changed, not connected, empty dict
description: An empty dict counts as no value, like None, an empty string or an empty list.

name: prompt variable fields
description: The saved node lists its extra field in custom_fields, so the component rebuilds it.

name: prompt variable plus a removed field
description: custom_fields covers the variable, not the other field the component dropped.

name: editor metadata on the saved node
description: The saved node carries editor runtime keys the component does not declare.

name: tool mode, component still supports it
description: The saved node is in tool mode and the component still has a tool-mode input.

name: tool mode, component dropped it
description: The saved node is in tool mode and the component has no tool-mode input.

name: input field type changed, not connected, empty list
description: An empty list counts as no value, like None, an empty string or an empty dict.

name: saved-only field named constructor
description: A field only the saved node has is removed, even when its name is an object property name in JavaScript.

name: new required field named toString, no default
description: A new required field with nothing to fill it needs input, even when its name is an object property name in JavaScript.

name: connected field now hidden
description: The component now declares the connected field hidden. The update keeps connected fields shown, so the edge stays.

name: field now hidden, not connected
description: The component now declares the field hidden, and no edge goes into it, so the update drops nothing.

name: connected field hidden on both sides
description: The saved node already has the connected field hidden. The editor drops an edge into a hidden field when the flow loads, before any update, so the update itself drops nothing more.

name: tool mode, connected field now marked tool_mode
description: The saved node is in tool mode and the component now marks a connected field tool_mode. The editor drops edges into tool-mode fields of a tool-mode node.

name: tool mode, field now marked tool_mode, not connected
description: The saved node is in tool mode and the component now marks a field tool_mode, but no edge goes into it.

name: connected field now marked tool_mode, not in tool mode
description: The component now marks a connected field tool_mode, but the saved node is not in tool mode, so the edge stays.

name: retired component
description: The component was retired; the saved node fails when the flow runs.

name: retired component, code unchanged
description: Retired wins over ok: the code equals the current code.

name: retired component, edited
description: Retired wins over a node the user edited.

name: retired component without a template
description: The retired entry carries no template. Retired still wins: the component exists and fails when the flow runs.

name: customized component
description: The user edited the code or dismissed an update, so nothing overwrites the node.

name: edited flag that is an empty list
description: Only edited set to true marks a customized node. Python and JavaScript disagree on whether an empty list is true, so neither copy reads it.

name: edited flag that is a string
description: Only edited set to true marks a customized node, not the string "true".

name: customized component, code unchanged
description: Ok wins over customized: the saved code equals the current code.

name: customized component with a breaking change
description: Customized wins over breaking.
